scripts.build:content: svelte-kit sync && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --mode seed && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --mode main && cp node_modules/@ffmpeg/core/dist/esm/ffmpeg-core.{js,wasm} static/
scripts.build:worker: svelte-kit sync && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --mode worker
scripts.build: bun run build:worker && vite build && cp node_modules/@ffmpeg/core/dist/esm/ffmpeg-core.{js,wasm} build/
scripts.build:all: bun run build:content && bun run build
scripts.lint: bun run lint:format && bun run lint:eslint
scripts.lint:format: prettier --check .github/workflows/quality.yml eslint.config.js package.json prettier.config.js src/lib/bilibili-types.test.ts src/lib/download.test.ts src/lib/fetch-utils.test.ts src/lib/schemas.test.ts src/lib/sentry-reporting.test.ts src/lib/sentry-reporting.ts src/lib/utils.test.ts
scripts.package: bun run build:all && cd build && zip -r ../extension.zip . -x '.*'
